title: OGAuction
description: A modern and highly configurable Auction House plugin for Minecraft 1.21+
body:
(https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cf220d357eb0a02c9c94aaeb825178d16b677f7_0.webp)**

### **🔥 OGAuction
### **

Features:
✔ Auction House GUI
✔ Item Selling
✔ Bidding System
✔ SQLite & MySQL
✔ Vault Support
✔ Bedrock Support
✔ Configurable GUI
✔ ActionBar Notifications
✔ Category System
✔ Collect GUI
✔ Expired Items GUI
✔ Transaction Logs
✔ Async Database Operations

Commands:
/ah
/auction
/ah sell <price>
/ah bid <price>
/ah collect
/ah expired

Permissions:
ogauction.use
ogauction.sell
ogauction.bid
ogauction.tax.bypass
ogauction.limit.5
ogauction.limit.10
ogauction.limit.unlimited

Required:
• Vault

Optional:
• PlaceholderAPI
• Floodgate
• Geyser

Supported:
• SQLite
• MySQL
• LuckPerms
• EssentialsX Economy
